headline: Great news: Chiefs get the ball back!
what_happened: K.Fulton caught a pass meant for the other team, which is called an interception.
who: K.Fulton intercepted the ball from D.Jones.
why_it_matters: This is a big win for the Chiefs because it stops the other team from moving closer to scoring. It boosts their chances of winning significantly and gives our team a new chance to score.
pop_culture: This exciting play set the stage for a touchdown by Travis Kelce on the very next drive.
